paragraphs: The GLC350e has been part of the GLC-Class range since 2020, spanning two generations as a plug-in hybrid variant. The earlier X253 generation uses the M274 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine paired with a 13.5kWh electric motor and battery. From the X254 generation onwards (2025), the GLC350e switched to the M254, a newer 2.0-litre four-cylinder unit with mild-hybrid and plug-in hybrid integration, offering an electric-only range of up to 54 miles in its latest form. The GLC350e was discontinued in X253 form but returned for the X254 generation as a 2025 model-year addition.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLC350E on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the GLC350e from 2020 to 2022, during the X253 generation. It was paired with a 13.5kWh battery and electric motor as part of the plug-in hybrid system.

The current 2.0-litre four-cylinder unit fitted to the GLC350e from 2025 onwards in the X254 generation. This is a newer design with mild-hybrid and plug-in hybrid integration, offering improved efficiency and a quoted 54-mile electric-only range.

compatibility.intro: Because the GLC350e spans two distinct engines across two generations, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an M274 part will work on an M254 car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
